name: Hat blocking
summary: A milliner steams a felt or straw hat body and pulls it over a carved wooden block, so that it dries in the shape of the crown and the brim.
how: Soften the hat body with steam or hot water.
Pull the body down over the block and tie it at the crown line with a cord.
Dry it on the block, then trim the brim edge and sew in the lining.

origin.note: Hatters block felt on carved wood blocks long before the Victorian trade; the method scales up with the many hat shapes of the 19th century.

adoptions.via: Victorian milliners block felt and straw bodies for each season's bonnet and hat shape.
